2317-6798-7084-8345.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat.

1671-2645-2930-3430.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Portent Tracker by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Portent Tracker.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1742-1978-2734-3363.notablePrerequisites: The One Ring has a burden counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
1742-1978-2734-3363.description:
Animate The One Ring using Cyberdrive Awakener.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and drawing a card for each burden counter on it.
Activate Skirge Familiar twice by discarding two cards, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The One Ring.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Greenwarden of Murasa for its evoke cost by paying {2} due to Urza's Incubator
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa with haste.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

856-5270-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it and Samwise triggers.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain one life.
Resolve the Samwise trigger, creating a Food token.
Repeat.
856-5270-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1394-2034-2060-7038-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
1394-2034-2060-7038-7803.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Brad Boimler.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Brad Boimler.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-1974-4890.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-1974-4890.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Quicksilver Gargantuan and Dack's Duplicate each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Quicksilver Gargantuan trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Dack's Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-1974-4890.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

703-4865-7149.description:
Cast Vesuvan Shapeshifter by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Vesuvan Shapeshifter into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Vesuvan Shapeshifter dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Astral Dragon, gaining its abilities.
When Vesuvan Shapeshifter enters, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Put all but one of the Vesuvan Shapeshifters into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Vesuvan Shapeshifter tokens each trigger. Resolve a trigger, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 5.
703-4865-7149.notes: The additional triggers can copy whatever noncreature permanent(s) you desire.

252-997-1575-5776.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
As the creature is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Ygra's second ability and Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger, creating a tapped Treasure token. The Treasure will enter as a 7/7 Dinosaur Food in addition to its types due to Displaced Dinosaurs and Ygra.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
252-997-1575-5776.notes: The combo can instead by started by sacrificing an untapped noncreature Food to its own ability. This will replace step 1 for the first iteration and add {2} to the mana needed. After the first iteration, follow the steps above as normal.

Cast Kirol either from your hand or the command zone by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Kirol enters, Molten Echoes triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and another creature you control, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Molten Echoes's ability, creating three token copies of Kirol with haste.
Holding priority, activate a Kirol token by tapping two Kirol tokens, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Karmic Guide
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

907-4826-5702-6850.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
907-4826-5702-6850.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary. When it enters untapped due to Archelos, Selesnya Sanctuary and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Icetill Explorer.
Because of the additional Icetill Explorer token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

3234-3293-5226-5686.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5226-5686.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-5226-5686.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

Activate Trazyn using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Trazyn and adding {U} for each charge counter on Trazyn.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.

Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.

Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat during each combat phase.

440-1339-2034-4476.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.

Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.

Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.

Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis' third ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.

Activate Pentad Prism twice by removing both charge counters from it, adding {2} in two different colors.
Activate Teferi's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, returning Pentad Prism from the battlefield to your hand and drawing a card.
Repeat.

757-2003-2348-5087.notablePrerequisites:
Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
It is your precombat main phase.
757-2003-2348-5087.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Contagion Engine by paying {6} and tapping it, putting two eon counters on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, putting two eon counters on Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
